name: Shree Metalloys Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1994, Shree Metalloys Ltd 
trades in ferrous and non-ferrous metals[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
SML is a Gujarat-based company engaged in trading of ferrous and non-ferrous metals. The company also extended its area of operations 
to the manufacturing sector of non-ferrous metals by carrying out job work at its manufacturing facility for metal alloy wires (zipper wires). These are used in ball pen manufacturing.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 9.29% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
